279: func (h *operationHub) finish(record *operationRecord, result app.OperationResult, runErr error) {
280: 	finished := h.now().UTC()
281: 	h.mu.Lock()
282: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
283: 	if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
284: 		return
285: 	}
286: 	state := "succeeded"
287: 	switch {
288: 	case errors.Is(runErr, context.Canceled), result.State == app.OperationCancelled:
289: 		state = "cancelled"
290: 	case runErr != nil, result.State == app.OperationFailed:
291: 		state = "failed"
292: 	case result.State == app.OperationPartial:
293: 		state = "interrupted"
294: 	}
295: 	record.doc.State = state
296: 	record.doc.FinishedAt = &finished
297: 	record.doc.Result = projectOperationResult(result)
298: 	h.appendEventLocked(record, "terminal", map[string]any{"state": state, "reason": record.doc.Reason, "result": record.doc.Result})
299: 	h.active--
300: 	h.counters.active.Add(-1)
301: 	h.counters.terminal.Add(1)
302: 	close(record.done)
303: 	for id, subscriber := range record.subscribers {
304: 		close(subscriber.ch)
305: 		delete(record.subscribers, id)
306: 		h.streams--
307: 		h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
308: 	}
309: }

333: 			Project: record.request.Project, Sprint: record.request.Sprint, Study: record.request.Study,

349: 	record := h.records[id]
350: 	if record == nil || (session != "" && record.session != session) {
351: 		h.mu.Unlock()

388: 	if lastID > 0 && len(record.events) > 0 && lastID < record.events[0].ID-1 {
389: 		h.counters.replayGaps.Add(1)
390: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "recovery_required", map[string]any{
391: 			"oldest_retained_id": strconv.FormatUint(record.events[0].ID, 10),
392: 			"newest_retained_id": strconv.FormatUint(record.nextEventID, 10),
393: 			"refresh_path":       record.doc.DurableStatus.RefreshPath,
394: 		})
395: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "snapshot", map[string]any{"state": record.doc.State, "reason": record.doc.Reason})
396: 	}
397: 	replay := make([]operationEvent, 0, len(record.events))
398: 	for _, event := range record.events {
399: 		if event.ID > lastID {
400: 			replay = append(replay, event)
401: 		}
402: 	}
403: 	record.nextSubID++
404: 	sub := &operationSubscriber{id: record.nextSubID, ch: make(chan operationEvent, SubscriberQueueSize)}
405: 	if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
406: 		close(sub.ch)
407: 	} else {
408: 		record.subscribers[sub.id] = sub
409: 		h.streams++
410: 		h.counters.activeStreams.Add(1)
411: 	}
412: 	var once sync.Once
413: 	unsubscribe := func() {
414: 		once.Do(func() {
415: 			h.mu.Lock()
416: 			defer h.mu.Unlock()
417: 			if current, ok := record.subscribers[sub.id]; ok {
418: 				delete(record.subscribers, sub.id)
419: 				h.streams--
420: 				h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
421: 				close(current.ch)
422: 			}
423: 		})
424: 	}
425: 	return replay, sub.ch, unsubscribe, nil

428: func (h *operationHub) appendEventLocked(record *operationRecord, name string, payload any) {
429: 	name = stableOperationEventName(name)
430: 	record.nextEventID++
431: 	body := map[string]any{
432: 		"operation_id": record.doc.ID,
433: 		"time":         h.now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
434: 		"sequence":     record.nextEventID,
435: 		"payload":      payload,
436: 	}
437: 	data, err := json.Marshal(body)
438: 	if err != nil {
439: 		h.counters.projectionDrops.Add(1)
440: 		return
441: 	}
442: 	if len(data) > MaxEncodedEventBytes {
443: 		data, _ = json.Marshal(map[string]any{
444: 			"operation_id": record.doc.ID, "time": h.now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
445: 			"sequence": record.nextEventID, "payload": map[string]any{"message": "event projection exceeded the safe size limit"},
446: 		})
447: 		name = "warning"
448: 	}
449: 	event := operationEvent{ID: record.nextEventID, Name: name, Data: data}
450: 	record.events = append(record.events, event)
451: 	record.eventBytes += len(data)
452: 	for len(record.events) > MaxEventsPerOperation || record.eventBytes > MaxEventBytesPerOperation {
453: 		record.eventBytes -= len(record.events[0].Data)
454: 		record.events = record.events[1:]
455: 	}
456: 	record.doc.LastEventID = strconv.FormatUint(event.ID, 10)
457: 	for id, subscriber := range record.subscribers {
458: 		select {
459: 		case subscriber.ch <- event:
460: 		default:
461: 			close(subscriber.ch)
462: 			delete(record.subscribers, id)
463: 			h.streams--
464: 			h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
465: 			h.counters.slowSubscribers.Add(1)
466: 		}
467: 	}
468: }

470: func stableOperationEventName(name string) string {
471: 	switch name {
472: 	case "snapshot", "progress", "warning", "finding", "artifact", "cancel_requested", "recovery_required", "terminal":
473: 		return name
474: 	default:
475: 		return "progress"
476: 	}
477: }

479: func (h *operationHub) drainAndWait(ctx context.Context) error {
480: 	h.mu.Lock()
481: 	h.draining = true
482: 	var records []*operationRecord
483: 	for _, record := range h.records {
484: 		if !terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
485: 			records = append(records, record)
486: 		}
487: 	}
488: 	h.mu.Unlock()
489: 	for _, record := range records {
490: 		_, _, _ = h.cancelOperation("", record.doc.ID, "server_shutdown")
491: 	}
492: 	h.counters.shutdownCleanups.Add(int64(len(records)))
493: 	for _, record := range records {
494: 		select {
495: 		case <-record.done:
496: 		case <-ctx.Done():
497: 			persistErr := h.persistCleanupUncertain(records)
498: 			h.markCleanupUncertain(records)
499: 			return errors.Join(ctx.Err(), persistErr)
500: 		}
501: 	}
502: 	return nil
503: }
504: 
505: func (h *operationHub) persistCleanupUncertain(records []*operationRecord) error {
506: 	recorder, ok := h.ops.(app.OperationCleanupRecorder)
507: 	if !ok {
508: 		return errors.New("operation capability cannot persist cleanup uncertainty")
509: 	}
510: 	var result error
511: 	for _, record := range records {
512: 		h.mu.Lock()
513: 		terminal := terminalOperationState(record.doc.State)
514: 		h.mu.Unlock()
515: 		if terminal {
516: 			continue
517: 		}
518: 		persistCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
519: 		err := recorder.RecordOperationCleanupUncertain(persistCtx, app.OperationCleanupUncertain{
520: 			OperationID: record.doc.ID,
521: 			Request:     record.request,
522: 			Reason:      "server_shutdown",
523: 			RecordedAt:  h.now().UTC(),
524: 		})
525: 		cancel()
526: 		if err != nil {
527: 			result = errors.Join(result, fmt.Errorf("persist cleanup uncertainty for %s: %w", record.doc.ID, err))
528: 		}
529: 	}
530: 	return result
531: }
532: 
533: func (h *operationHub) markCleanupUncertain(records []*operationRecord) {
534: 	h.mu.Lock()
535: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
536: 	finished := h.now().UTC()
537: 	for _, record := range records {
538: 		if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
539: 			continue
540: 		}
541: 		record.doc.State = "cleanup_uncertain"
542: 		record.doc.Reason = "server_shutdown"
543: 		record.doc.FinishedAt = &finished
544: 		record.doc.Result = &operationResultDTO{State: "cleanup_uncertain", Message: "Cleanup did not finish before the shutdown deadline. Refresh durable status before retrying."}
545: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "terminal", map[string]any{"state": record.doc.State, "reason": record.doc.Reason})
546: 		h.active--
547: 		h.counters.active.Add(-1)
548: 		h.counters.terminal.Add(1)
549: 		close(record.done)
550: 		for id, subscriber := range record.subscribers {
551: 			close(subscriber.ch)
552: 			delete(record.subscribers, id)
553: 			h.streams--
554: 			h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
555: 		}
556: 	}
557: }

559: func (h *operationHub) isDraining() bool {
560: 	h.mu.Lock()
561: 	defer h.mu.Unlock()
562: 	return h.draining
563: }
564: 
565: func (h *operationHub) reapLocked() {
566: 	now := h.now().UTC()
567: 	for id, record := range h.records {
568: 		if record.doc.FinishedAt != nil && now.Sub(*record.doc.FinishedAt) >= TerminalRetention {
569: 			delete(h.records, id)
570: 			if record.dedupKey != "" {
571: 				delete(h.dedup, record.dedupKey)
572: 			}
573: 		}
574: 	}
575: }

577: func projectOperationResult(result app.OperationResult) *operationResultDTO {
578: 	out := &operationResultDTO{
579: 		State: safeWebText(string(result.State)), Subject: safeWebText(result.Subject), Message: safeWebText(result.Message),
580: 		Content: safeProjectedText(result.Content, MaxTerminalResultBytes/2), Truncated: result.Truncated,
581: 	}
582: 	for _, finding := range result.Findings {
583: 		out.Findings = append(out.Findings, findingDTO{
584: 			Severity: safeWebText(finding.Severity), Section: safeWebText(finding.Section), Problem: safeWebText(finding.Problem),
585: 			Cause: safeWebText(finding.Cause), Suggestion: safeWebText(finding.Suggestion),
586: 		})
587: 	}
588: 	if result.Error != nil {
589: 		out.Error = &errorBody{Code: safeWebText(result.Error.Code), Message: safeWebText(result.Error.Message), Retryable: result.Error.Retryable, Details: map[string]any{
590: 			"category": safeWebText(result.Error.Category), "component": safeWebText(result.Error.Component), "cause": safeWebText(result.Error.Cause), "guidance": safeWebText(result.Error.Guidance),
591: 		}}
592: 	}
593: 	if data, _ := json.Marshal(out); len(data) > MaxTerminalResultBytes {
594: 		out.Content = ""
595: 		out.Findings = nil
596: 		out.Truncated = true
597: 		out.Message = safeBoundedText(out.Message, 4096)
598: 	}
599: 	return out
600: }

602: func cloneOperationDocument(doc operationDocument) operationDocument {
603: 	clone := doc
604: 	if doc.Result != nil {
605: 		result := *doc.Result
606: 		result.Findings = append([]findingDTO(nil), doc.Result.Findings...)
607: 		if doc.Result.Error != nil {
608: 			err := *doc.Result.Error
609: 			result.Error = &err
610: 		}
611: 		clone.Result = &result
612: 	}
613: 	return clone
614: }

616: func terminalOperationState(state string) bool {
617: 	switch state {
618: 	case "succeeded", "failed", "cancelled", "interrupted", "cleanup_uncertain":
619: 		return true
620: 	default:
621: 		return false
622: 	}

626: 	switch reason {

628: 		return reason
629: 	default:

634: func safeWebText(value string) string {
635: 	return safeProjectedText(value, 4096)
636: }
637: 
638: func safeProjectedText(value string, limit int) string {
639: 	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
640: 	lower := strings.ToLower(value)
641: 	for _, marker := range []string{"token=", "secret=", "authorization:", "cookie:"} {
642: 		if index := strings.Index(lower, marker); index >= 0 {
643: 			value = value[:index] + "[redacted]"
644: 			lower = strings.ToLower(value)
645: 		}
646: 	}
647: 	if strings.Contains(value, "/home/") || strings.Contains(value, `C:\\Users\\`) {
648: 		value = "[redacted path]"
649: 	}
650: 	return safeBoundedText(value, limit)
651: }

653: func safeBoundedText(value string, limit int) string {
654: 	if len(value) <= limit {
655: 		return value
656: 	}
657: 	return value[:limit] + "…"
658: }

662: 		return 0, nil
663: 	}
664: 	id, err := strconv.ParseUint(value, 10, 64)
665: 	if err != nil {
666: 		return 0, fmt.Errorf("invalid Last-Event-ID")
667: 	}

301: 	h.counters.terminal.Add(1)

303: 	for id, subscriber := range record.subscribers {
304: 		close(subscriber.ch)
305: 		delete(record.subscribers, id)

307: 		h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)

428: func (h *operationHub) appendEventLocked(record *operationRecord, name string, payload any) {

445: 			"sequence": record.nextEventID, "payload": map[string]any{"message": "event projection exceeded the safe size limit"},

479: func (h *operationHub) drainAndWait(ctx context.Context) error {
480: 	h.mu.Lock()
481: 	h.draining = true
482: 	var records []*operationRecord
483: 	for _, record := range h.records {
484: 		if !terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
485: 			records = append(records, record)
486: 		}
487: 	}
488: 	h.mu.Unlock()
489: 	for _, record := range records {
490: 		_, _, _ = h.cancelOperation("", record.doc.ID, "server_shutdown")
491: 	}
492: 	h.counters.shutdownCleanups.Add(int64(len(records)))
493: 	for _, record := range records {
494: 		select {
495: 		case <-record.done:
496: 		case <-ctx.Done():
497: 			persistErr := h.persistCleanupUncertain(records)
498: 			h.markCleanupUncertain(records)
499: 			return errors.Join(ctx.Err(), persistErr)
500: 		}
501: 	}
502: 	return nil

505: func (h *operationHub) persistCleanupUncertain(records []*operationRecord) error {
506: 	recorder, ok := h.ops.(app.OperationCleanupRecorder)
507: 	if !ok {
508: 		return errors.New("operation capability cannot persist cleanup uncertainty")
509: 	}
510: 	var result error
511: 	for _, record := range records {
512: 		h.mu.Lock()
513: 		terminal := terminalOperationState(record.doc.State)
514: 		h.mu.Unlock()
515: 		if terminal {
516: 			continue
517: 		}
518: 		persistCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Second)
519: 		err := recorder.RecordOperationCleanupUncertain(persistCtx, app.OperationCleanupUncertain{
520: 			OperationID: record.doc.ID,
521: 			Request:     record.request,
522: 			Reason:      "server_shutdown",
523: 			RecordedAt:  h.now().UTC(),
524: 		})
525: 		cancel()
526: 		if err != nil {
527: 			result = errors.Join(result, fmt.Errorf("persist cleanup uncertainty for %s: %w", record.doc.ID, err))
528: 		}
529: 	}
530: 	return result

538: 		if terminalOperationState(record.doc.State) {
539: 			continue
540: 		}
541: 		record.doc.State = "cleanup_uncertain"
542: 		record.doc.Reason = "server_shutdown"
543: 		record.doc.FinishedAt = &finished
544: 		record.doc.Result = &operationResultDTO{State: "cleanup_uncertain", Message: "Cleanup did not finish before the shutdown deadline. Refresh durable status before retrying."}
545: 		h.appendEventLocked(record, "terminal", map[string]any{"state": record.doc.State, "reason": record.doc.Reason})
546: 		h.active--
547: 		h.counters.active.Add(-1)
548: 		h.counters.terminal.Add(1)

550: 		for id, subscriber := range record.subscribers {
551: 			close(subscriber.ch)
552: 			delete(record.subscribers, id)
553: 			h.streams--
554: 			h.counters.activeStreams.Add(-1)
555: 		}
556: 	}
557: }

565: func (h *operationHub) reapLocked() {
566: 	now := h.now().UTC()

570: 			if record.dedupKey != "" {
571: 				delete(h.dedup, record.dedupKey)
572: 			}

574: 	}

577: func projectOperationResult(result app.OperationResult) *operationResultDTO {
578: 	out := &operationResultDTO{
579: 		State: safeWebText(string(result.State)), Subject: safeWebText(result.Subject), Message: safeWebText(result.Message),
580: 		Content: safeProjectedText(result.Content, MaxTerminalResultBytes/2), Truncated: result.Truncated,
581: 	}
582: 	for _, finding := range result.Findings {
583: 		out.Findings = append(out.Findings, findingDTO{
584: 			Severity: safeWebText(finding.Severity), Section: safeWebText(finding.Section), Problem: safeWebText(finding.Problem),
585: 			Cause: safeWebText(finding.Cause), Suggestion: safeWebText(finding.Suggestion),
586: 		})
587: 	}
588: 	if result.Error != nil {
589: 		out.Error = &errorBody{Code: safeWebText(result.Error.Code), Message: safeWebText(result.Error.Message), Retryable: result.Error.Retryable, Details: map[string]any{
590: 			"category": safeWebText(result.Error.Category), "component": safeWebText(result.Error.Component), "cause": safeWebText(result.Error.Cause), "guidance": safeWebText(result.Error.Guidance),
591: 		}}
592: 	}
593: 	if data, _ := json.Marshal(out); len(data) > MaxTerminalResultBytes {
594: 		out.Content = ""
595: 		out.Findings = nil
596: 		out.Truncated = true
597: 		out.Message = safeBoundedText(out.Message, 4096)
598: 	}
599: 	return out
600: }

602: func cloneOperationDocument(doc operationDocument) operationDocument {
603: 	clone := doc
604: 	if doc.Result != nil {
605: 		result := *doc.Result
606: 		result.Findings = append([]findingDTO(nil), doc.Result.Findings...)
607: 		if doc.Result.Error != nil {
608: 			err := *doc.Result.Error
609: 			result.Error = &err
610: 		}
611: 		clone.Result = &result
612: 	}
613: 	return clone
614: }

616: func terminalOperationState(state string) bool {
617: 	switch state {
618: 	case "succeeded", "failed", "cancelled", "interrupted", "cleanup_uncertain":
619: 		return true
620: 	default:
621: 		return false
622: 	}

631: 	}

638: func safeProjectedText(value string, limit int) string {
639: 	value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
640: 	lower := strings.ToLower(value)
641: 	for _, marker := range []string{"token=", "secret=", "authorization:", "cookie:"} {
642: 		if index := strings.Index(lower, marker); index >= 0 {
643: 			value = value[:index] + "[redacted]"

648: 		value = "[redacted path]"
649: 	}

654: 	if len(value) <= limit {
655: 		return value
656: 	}

658: }

230: func (h *handler) handleOperationEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string) {
231: 	lastID, err := parseEventID(r.Header.Get("Last-Event-ID"))
232: 	if err != nil {
233: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
234: 		return
235: 	}
236: 	replay, events, unsubscribe, err := h.hub.subscribe(sessionID(r.Context()), id, lastID)
237: 	if err != nil {
238: 		if h.followDurableOperationEvents(w, r, id, lastID) {
239: 			return
240: 		}
241: 		if legacyOperationID(id) {
242: 			h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusGone, "legacy_operation_not_retained", "This pre-durable operation is no longer retained. Refresh the owning product or inspect canonical workspace runs.")
243: 			return
244: 		}
245: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, err)
246: 		return
247: 	}
248: 	defer unsubscribe()
249: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
250: 	if !ok {
251: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("streaming unavailable"))
252: 		return
253: 	}
254: 	_ = http.NewResponseController(w).SetWriteDeadline(h.now().Add(MaxStreamLifetime + SSEHeartbeat))
255: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
256: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
257: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
258: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
259: 	for _, event := range replay {
260: 		if err := writeSSEEvent(w, event); err != nil {
261: 			return
262: 		}
263: 	}
264: 	flusher.Flush()
265: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
266: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
267: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
268: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
269: 	for {
270: 		select {
271: 		case event, open := <-events:
272: 			if !open {
273: 				flusher.Flush()
274: 				return
275: 			}
276: 			if err := writeSSEEvent(w, event); err != nil {
277: 				return
278: 			}
279: 			flusher.Flush()
280: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
281: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
282: 				return
283: 			}
284: 			flusher.Flush()
285: 		case <-lifetime.C:
286: 			return
287: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
288: 			return
289: 		}
290: 	}
291: }

444: // followDurableOperationEvents is the compatibility projection for a run that
445: // was accepted by this or another local server but is absent from this
446: // process's transient operation hub.
447: func (h *handler) followDurableOperationEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string, after uint64) bool {
448: 	if h.runs == nil {
449: 		return false
450: 	}
451: 	snapshot, err := h.runs.Run(r.Context(), app.RunID(id))
452: 	if err != nil || string(snapshot.RunID) != id || snapshot.Target.Kind != "operation" {
453: 		return false
454: 	}
455: 	if after > snapshot.LastSequence {
456: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "cursor_ahead", "The event cursor is ahead of the durable operation.")
457: 		return true
458: 	}
459: 	if after+1 < snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence {
460: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "replay_gap", "The requested operation history is no longer retained; refresh its canonical run.")
461: 		return true
462: 	}
463: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
464: 	if !ok {
465: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("streaming unavailable"))
466: 		return true
467: 	}
468: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
469: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
470: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
471: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
472: 	flusher.Flush()
473: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
474: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
475: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
476: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
477: 	poll := time.NewTimer(0)
478: 	defer poll.Stop()
479: 	for {
480: 		select {
481: 		case <-poll.C:
482: 			events, eventErr := h.runs.RunEvents(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID, after, 512)
483: 			if eventErr != nil {
484: 				return true
485: 			}
486: 			for _, event := range events {
487: 				projected := durableOperationEvent(event)
488: 				if err := writeSSEEvent(w, projected); err != nil {
489: 					return true
490: 				}
491: 				after = event.Sequence
492: 			}
493: 			flusher.Flush()
494: 			snapshot, eventErr = h.runs.Run(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID)
495: 			if eventErr != nil || snapshot.Lifecycle.IsTerminal() && after >= snapshot.LastSequence {
496: 				return true
497: 			}
498: 			wait := time.Second
499: 			if len(events) == 512 || after < snapshot.LastSequence {
500: 				wait = 250 * time.Millisecond
501: 			}
502: 			poll.Reset(wait)
503: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
504: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
505: 				return true
506: 			}
507: 			flusher.Flush()
508: 		case <-lifetime.C:
509: 			return true
510: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
511: 			return true
512: 		}
513: 	}
514: }

516: func durableOperationEvent(event app.RunEvent) operationEvent {
517: 	name := "progress"
518: 	switch string(event.Type) {
519: 	case "accepted", "claimed", "lifecycle":
520: 		name = "snapshot"
521: 	case "warning", "finding", "artifact", "terminal":
522: 		name = string(event.Type)
523: 	case "cancellation":
524: 		name = "cancel_requested"
525: 	case "recovery", "omission":
526: 		name = "recovery_required"
527: 	}
528: 	payload := map[string]any{"stage": event.Stage, "task": event.Task, "payload": event.Payload, "omission": event.Omission}
529: 	body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
530: 		"operation_id": string(event.RunID), "time": event.CommittedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
531: 		"sequence": event.Sequence, "payload": payload,
532: 	})
533: 	return operationEvent{ID: event.Sequence, Name: name, Data: body}
534: }

555: func newSprintRef(number, name string) string {
556: 	number = strings.TrimSpace(number)
557: 	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
558: 	if number == "" || name == "" {
559: 		return ""
560: 	}
561: 	for _, r := range number {
562: 		if r < '0' || r > '9' {
563: 			return number + "-" + name
564: 		}
565: 	}
566: 	var slug strings.Builder
567: 	separator := false
568: 	for _, r := range strings.ToLower(name) {
569: 		switch {
570: 		case r >= 'a' && r <= 'z', r >= '0' && r <= '9':
571: 			if separator && slug.Len() > 0 {
572: 				slug.WriteByte('-')
573: 			}
574: 			slug.WriteRune(r)
575: 			separator = false
576: 		case r == ' ' || r == '-' || r == '_':
577: 			separator = true
578: 		default:
579: 			return number + "-" + name
580: 		}
581: 	}
582: 	if slug.Len() == 0 {
583: 		return ""
584: 	}
585: 	return number + "-" + slug.String()
586: }

593: func decodeStrictJSON(r *http.Request, target any) error {
594: 	contentType := r.Header.Get("Content-Type")
595: 	if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(contentType), "application/json") {
596: 		return fmt.Errorf("Content-Type must be application/json")
597: 	}
598: 	decoder := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
599: 	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
600: 	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
601: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON request: %w", err)
602: 	}
603: 	var extra any
604: 	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
605: 		return fmt.Errorf("request must contain one JSON value")
606: 	}
607: 	return nil
608: }

610: func mapOperationRequest(spec operationSpecRequest) (app.OperationRequest, error) {
611: 	if !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Project) || !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Sprint) || !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Study) {
612: 		return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("operation scope contains an invalid identifier")
613: 	}
614: 	options := spec.Options
615: 	req := app.OperationRequest{
616: 		Project: spec.Scope.Project, Sprint: spec.Scope.Sprint, Study: spec.Scope.Study,
617: 		Stage: firstString(options.ToStage, options.Stage), Task: options.Task, Model: options.Model,
618: 		Level: options.Level, Suite: options.Suite, Test: options.Test, Timeout: options.Timeout,
619: 		ForceReview: options.ForceReview, RestartReview: options.RestartReview, OverrideRationale: options.OverrideRationale,
620: 		ReviewFocus: options.ReviewFocus, Sources: options.Sources, Dimensions: options.Dimensions, Parallelism: options.Parallelism,
621: 	}
622: 	kind := strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimSpace(spec.Kind), "_", "-")
623: 	switch kind {
624: 	case "validation", "validate":
625: 		req.Kind = app.OperationValidate
626: 	case "sprint-status":
627: 		req.Kind = app.OperationSprintStatus
628: 	case "prompt-preview", "sprint-prompt":
629: 		req.Kind = app.OperationPrompt
630: 	case "dry-run", "sprint-flow-dry-run":
631: 		req.Kind = app.OperationFlowDryRun
632: 	case "sprint-flow":
633: 		if options.DryRun {
634: 			req.Kind = app.OperationFlowDryRun
635: 		} else {
636: 			req.Kind = app.OperationFlow
637: 		}
638: 	case "sprint-stage":
639: 		if options.DryRun {
640: 			req.Kind = app.OperationStageDryRun
641: 		} else {
642: 			req.Kind = app.OperationStage

254: 	_ = http.NewResponseController(w).SetWriteDeadline(h.now().Add(MaxStreamLifetime + SSEHeartbeat))
255: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
256: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
257: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
258: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
259: 	for _, event := range replay {
260: 		if err := writeSSEEvent(w, event); err != nil {
261: 			return
262: 		}
263: 	}
264: 	flusher.Flush()
265: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
266: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
267: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
268: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
269: 	for {
270: 		select {
271: 		case event, open := <-events:
272: 			if !open {
273: 				flusher.Flush()
274: 				return
275: 			}
276: 			if err := writeSSEEvent(w, event); err != nil {
277: 				return
278: 			}
279: 			flusher.Flush()
280: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
281: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
282: 				return
283: 			}
284: 			flusher.Flush()
285: 		case <-lifetime.C:
286: 			return
287: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
288: 			return
289: 		}
290: 	}
291: }

444: // followDurableOperationEvents is the compatibility projection for a run that
445: // was accepted by this or another local server but is absent from this
446: // process's transient operation hub.
447: func (h *handler) followDurableOperationEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, id string, after uint64) bool {
448: 	if h.runs == nil {
449: 		return false
450: 	}
451: 	snapshot, err := h.runs.Run(r.Context(), app.RunID(id))
452: 	if err != nil || string(snapshot.RunID) != id || snapshot.Target.Kind != "operation" {
453: 		return false
454: 	}
455: 	if after > snapshot.LastSequence {
456: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "cursor_ahead", "The event cursor is ahead of the durable operation.")
457: 		return true
458: 	}
459: 	if after+1 < snapshot.OldestRetainedSequence {
460: 		h.writeError(w, r, http.StatusConflict, "replay_gap", "The requested operation history is no longer retained; refresh its canonical run.")
461: 		return true
462: 	}
463: 	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
464: 	if !ok {
465: 		h.writeOperationError(w, r, errors.New("streaming unavailable"))
466: 		return true
467: 	}
468: 	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream; charset=utf-8")
469: 	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
470: 	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
471: 	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusOK)
472: 	flusher.Flush()
473: 	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(SSEHeartbeat)
474: 	defer heartbeat.Stop()
475: 	lifetime := time.NewTimer(MaxStreamLifetime)
476: 	defer lifetime.Stop()
477: 	poll := time.NewTimer(0)
478: 	defer poll.Stop()
479: 	for {
480: 		select {
481: 		case <-poll.C:
482: 			events, eventErr := h.runs.RunEvents(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID, after, 512)
483: 			if eventErr != nil {
484: 				return true
485: 			}
486: 			for _, event := range events {
487: 				projected := durableOperationEvent(event)
488: 				if err := writeSSEEvent(w, projected); err != nil {
489: 					return true
490: 				}
491: 				after = event.Sequence
492: 			}
493: 			flusher.Flush()
494: 			snapshot, eventErr = h.runs.Run(r.Context(), snapshot.RunID)
495: 			if eventErr != nil || snapshot.Lifecycle.IsTerminal() && after >= snapshot.LastSequence {
496: 				return true
497: 			}
498: 			wait := time.Second
499: 			if len(events) == 512 || after < snapshot.LastSequence {
500: 				wait = 250 * time.Millisecond
501: 			}
502: 			poll.Reset(wait)
503: 		case <-heartbeat.C:
504: 			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": heartbeat\n\n"); err != nil {
505: 				return true
506: 			}
507: 			flusher.Flush()
508: 		case <-lifetime.C:
509: 			return true
510: 		case <-r.Context().Done():
511: 			return true
512: 		}
513: 	}
514: }

516: func durableOperationEvent(event app.RunEvent) operationEvent {
517: 	name := "progress"
518: 	switch string(event.Type) {
519: 	case "accepted", "claimed", "lifecycle":
520: 		name = "snapshot"
521: 	case "warning", "finding", "artifact", "terminal":
522: 		name = string(event.Type)
523: 	case "cancellation":
524: 		name = "cancel_requested"
525: 	case "recovery", "omission":
526: 		name = "recovery_required"
527: 	}
528: 	payload := map[string]any{"stage": event.Stage, "task": event.Task, "payload": event.Payload, "omission": event.Omission}
529: 	body, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{
530: 		"operation_id": string(event.RunID), "time": event.CommittedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano),
531: 		"sequence": event.Sequence, "payload": payload,
532: 	})
533: 	return operationEvent{ID: event.Sequence, Name: name, Data: body}
534: }

555: func newSprintRef(number, name string) string {
556: 	number = strings.TrimSpace(number)
557: 	name = strings.TrimSpace(name)
558: 	if number == "" || name == "" {
559: 		return ""
560: 	}
561: 	for _, r := range number {
562: 		if r < '0' || r > '9' {
563: 			return number + "-" + name
564: 		}
565: 	}
566: 	var slug strings.Builder
567: 	separator := false
568: 	for _, r := range strings.ToLower(name) {
569: 		switch {
570: 		case r >= 'a' && r <= 'z', r >= '0' && r <= '9':
571: 			if separator && slug.Len() > 0 {
572: 				slug.WriteByte('-')
573: 			}
574: 			slug.WriteRune(r)
575: 			separator = false
576: 		case r == ' ' || r == '-' || r == '_':
577: 			separator = true
578: 		default:
579: 			return number + "-" + name
580: 		}
581: 	}
582: 	if slug.Len() == 0 {
583: 		return ""
584: 	}
585: 	return number + "-" + slug.String()
586: }

593: func decodeStrictJSON(r *http.Request, target any) error {
594: 	contentType := r.Header.Get("Content-Type")
595: 	if !strings.HasPrefix(strings.ToLower(contentType), "application/json") {
596: 		return fmt.Errorf("Content-Type must be application/json")
597: 	}
598: 	decoder := json.NewDecoder(r.Body)
599: 	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
600: 	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
601: 		return fmt.Errorf("invalid JSON request: %w", err)
602: 	}
603: 	var extra any
604: 	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
605: 		return fmt.Errorf("request must contain one JSON value")
606: 	}
607: 	return nil
608: }

610: func mapOperationRequest(spec operationSpecRequest) (app.OperationRequest, error) {
611: 	if !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Project) || !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Sprint) || !validOptionalIdentifier(spec.Scope.Study) {
612: 		return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("operation scope contains an invalid identifier")
613: 	}
614: 	options := spec.Options
615: 	req := app.OperationRequest{
616: 		Project: spec.Scope.Project, Sprint: spec.Scope.Sprint, Study: spec.Scope.Study,
617: 		Stage: firstString(options.ToStage, options.Stage), Task: options.Task, Model: options.Model,
618: 		Level: options.Level, Suite: options.Suite, Test: options.Test, Timeout: options.Timeout,
619: 		ForceReview: options.ForceReview, RestartReview: options.RestartReview, OverrideRationale: options.OverrideRationale,
620: 		ReviewFocus: options.ReviewFocus, Sources: options.Sources, Dimensions: options.Dimensions, Parallelism: options.Parallelism,
621: 	}
622: 	kind := strings.ReplaceAll(strings.TrimSpace(spec.Kind), "_", "-")
623: 	switch kind {
624: 	case "validation", "validate":
625: 		req.Kind = app.OperationValidate
626: 	case "sprint-status":
627: 		req.Kind = app.OperationSprintStatus
628: 	case "prompt-preview", "sprint-prompt":
629: 		req.Kind = app.OperationPrompt
630: 	case "dry-run", "sprint-flow-dry-run":
631: 		req.Kind = app.OperationFlowDryRun
632: 	case "sprint-flow":
633: 		if options.DryRun {
634: 			req.Kind = app.OperationFlowDryRun
635: 		} else {
636: 			req.Kind = app.OperationFlow
637: 		}
638: 	case "sprint-stage":
639: 		if options.DryRun {
640: 			req.Kind = app.OperationStageDryRun
641: 		} else {
642: 			req.Kind = app.OperationStage
643: 		}
644: 	case "sprint-stage-dry-run":
645: 		req.Kind = app.OperationStageDryRun
646: 	case "execute", "execute-start":
647: 		switch {
648: 		case options.Action == "status":
649: 			req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteStatus
650: 		case options.DryRun:
651: 			req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteDryRun
652: 		case options.Resume:
653: 			req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteResume
654: 		default:
655: 			req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteStart
656: 		}
657: 	case "execute-status":
658: 		req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteStatus
659: 	case "execute-dry-run":
660: 		req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteDryRun
661: 	case "execute-resume":
662: 		req.Kind = app.OperationExecuteResume
663: 	case "review", "review-start":
664: 		if options.Action == "status" {
665: 			req.Kind = app.OperationReviewStatus
666: 		} else if options.DryRun {
667: 			req.Kind = app.OperationReviewDryRun
668: 		} else {
669: 			req.Kind = app.OperationReviewStart
670: 		}
671: 	case "review-status":
672: 		req.Kind = app.OperationReviewStatus
673: 	case "review-dry-run":
674: 		req.Kind = app.OperationReviewDryRun
675: 	case "smoke", "smoke-start":
676: 		if options.Action == "status" {
677: 			req.Kind = app.OperationSmokeStatus
678: 		} else if options.DryRun {
679: 			req.Kind = app.OperationSmokeDryRun
680: 		} else {
681: 			req.Kind = app.OperationSmokeStart
682: 		}
683: 	case "smoke-status":
684: 		req.Kind = app.OperationSmokeStatus
685: 	case "smoke-dry-run":
686: 		req.Kind = app.OperationSmokeDryRun
687: 	case "verify", "verify-start":
688: 		if options.DryRun {
689: 			req.Kind = app.OperationVerifyDryRun
690: 		} else {
691: 			req.Kind = app.OperationVerifyStart
692: 		}
693: 	case "verify-dry-run":
694: 		req.Kind = app.OperationVerifyDryRun
695: 	case "qa-status":
696: 		req.Kind = app.OperationQAStatus
697: 	case "qa-dry-run":
698: 		req.Kind = app.OperationQADryRun
699: 	case "qa-start":
700: 		req.Kind = app.OperationQAStart
701: 		req.Task = options.Shard
702: 	case "qa-resume":
703: 		req.Kind = app.OperationQAResume
704: 		req.Task = options.Shard
705: 	case "qa-recover":
706: 		req.Kind = app.OperationQARecover
707: 	case "study-run-loop", "study-start":
708: 		if options.Resume {
709: 			req.Kind = app.OperationStudyResume
710: 		} else {
711: 			req.Kind = app.OperationStudyStart
712: 		}
713: 	case "study-resume":
714: 		req.Kind = app.OperationStudyResume
715: 	case "study-cancel":
716: 		req.Kind = app.OperationStudyCancel
717: 	default:
718: 		return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("unsupported operation kind %q", spec.Kind)
719: 	}
720: 	if req.Kind == app.OperationValidate {
721: 		if (req.Project == "") == (req.Study == "") {
722: 			return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("validation requires one project or study scope")
723: 		}
724: 	} else if strings.HasPrefix(string(req.Kind), "study-") {
725: 		if req.Study == "" || req.Project != "" || req.Sprint != "" {
726: 			return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("study operations require only scope.study")
727: 		}
728: 	} else if req.Project == "" {
729: 		return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("project operations require scope.project")
730: 	} else if req.Sprint == "" {
731: 		return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("sprint operations require scope.sprint")
732: 	}
733: 	if strings.HasPrefix(string(req.Kind), "qa-") {
734: 		if options.Task != "" || options.Model != "" || options.Stage != "" || options.ToStage != "" || options.Action != "" || options.DryRun || options.Resume || options.Level != "" || options.Suite != "" || options.Test != "" || options.Timeout != "" || options.ForceReview || options.RestartReview || options.OverrideRationale != "" || len(options.ReviewFocus) > 0 || len(options.Sources) > 0 || len(options.Dimensions) > 0 || options.Parallelism != 0 {
735: 			return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("QA operations accept only options.shard")
736: 		}
737: 		if options.Shard != "" && req.Kind != app.OperationQAStart && req.Kind != app.OperationQAResume {
738: 			return app.OperationRequest{}, fmt.Errorf("QA shard is valid only for start or resume")
739: 		}
740: 	}
741: 	return req, nil
742: }

744: func mapOperationSpec(req app.OperationRequest) map[string]any {

746: 	if req.Project != "" {
747: 		scope["project"] = req.Project

416: 	record := s.records[token]

262: func validOrigin(origin, expected string) bool {
263: 	if origin == "" {

269: // validCommandOrigin permits a browser shell or local reverse proxy to omit or
270: // rewrite only the port while preserving the exact numeric loopback address.
271: // Mutating requests still require the signed session and CSRF proof.
272: func validCommandOrigin(origin, expected string) bool {
273: 	return origin == expected
274: }
275: 
276: // validCommandRequestOrigin accepts the exact configured origin. It also
277: // tolerates browsers that remove a non-default port from Origin when their
278: // unforgeable fetch metadata and exact Referer still prove a same-origin
279: // request. Session and CSRF validation remain separate mandatory checks.
280: func validCommandRequestOrigin(r *http.Request, expected string) bool {
281: 	if validCommandOrigin(r.Header.Get("Origin"), expected) {
282: 		return true
283: 	}
284: 	if r.Header.Get("Sec-Fetch-Site") != "same-origin" {
285: 		return false
286: 	}
287: 	receivedURL, receivedErr := url.Parse(r.Header.Get("Origin"))
288: 	expectedURL, expectedErr := url.Parse(expected)
289: 	refererURL, refererErr := url.Parse(r.Header.Get("Referer"))
290: 	if receivedErr != nil || expectedErr != nil || refererErr != nil ||
291: 		receivedURL.User != nil || expectedURL.User != nil || refererURL.User != nil {
292: 		return false
293: 	}
294: 	return receivedURL.Scheme == expectedURL.Scheme &&
295: 		receivedURL.Hostname() == expectedURL.Hostname() &&
296: 		receivedURL.Port() == "" && expectedURL.Port() != "" &&
297: 		refererURL.Scheme+"://"+refererURL.Host == expected
298: }

309: // read-only pages and APIs too. Some browser shells normalize a loopback

311: // the exact authority. Mutations continue through the stricter command path.
312: func validReadRequestOrigin(r *http.Request, expected string) bool {
313: 	return r.Header.Get("Origin") == "" || validCommandRequestOrigin(r, expected)

386: func newPreparationStore(now func() time.Time, id func() string) *preparationStore {
387: 	if now == nil {
388: 		now = time.Now
389: 	}

396: func (s *preparationStore) issue(session string, confirmation app.Confirmation) (*preparationRecord, error) {
397: 	s.mu.Lock()
398: 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
399: 	s.reapLocked()
400: 	if len(s.records) >= MaxPreparations {
401: 		return nil, errOperationCapacity
402: 	}
403: 	record := &preparationRecord{
404: 		ID: "prep_" + s.id(), Token: "confirm_" + s.id(), Session: session,
405: 		Canonical: confirmation.CanonicalRequest, Fingerprint: confirmation.InputFingerprint,
406: 		Confirmation: confirmation, ExpiresAt: s.now().UTC().Add(PreparationTTL),
407: 	}
408: 	s.records[record.Token] = record
409: 	copy := *record
410: 	return &copy, nil
411: }

413: func (s *preparationStore) consume(token, session, canonical, fingerprint string) (app.Confirmation, error) {
414: 	s.mu.Lock()
415: 	defer s.mu.Unlock()
416: 	record := s.records[token]
417: 	if record == nil {
418: 		return app.Confirmation{}, errConfirmationReplayed
419: 	}
420: 	if record.Consumed {
421: 		return app.Confirmation{}, errConfirmationReplayed
422: 	}
423: 	if !s.now().UTC().Before(record.ExpiresAt) {
424: 		record.Consumed = true
425: 		return app.Confirmation{}, errConfirmationExpired
426: 	}
427: 	if record.Session != session || record.Canonical != canonical {
428: 		record.Consumed = true
429: 		return app.Confirmation{}, errConfirmationMismatch
430: 	}
431: 	if record.Fingerprint != fingerprint {
432: 		record.Consumed = true
433: 		return app.Confirmation{}, errStaleConfirmation
434: 	}
435: 	record.Consumed = true
436: 	return record.Confirmation, nil
437: }

439: func (s *preparationStore) reapLocked() {
440: 	now := s.now().UTC()
441: 	for token, record := range s.records {
442: 		if !now.Before(record.ExpiresAt) {
443: 			delete(s.records, token)
444: 		}
445: 	}
446: }

681: // projectRoadmap parses the project's governed roadmap and joins each entry
682: // with live sprint state when the sprint workspace exists.
683: func (u *webUseCases) projectRoadmap(projectName string, live map[string]SprintSummary) []WebRoadmapPhase {
684: 	content, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(u.root, "projects", projectName, "roadmap.md"))
685: 	if err != nil {
686: 		return nil
687: 	}
688: 	parsed, _ := project.ParseRoadmap(string(content))
689: 	phases := make([]WebRoadmapPhase, 0, len(parsed.Phases))
690: 	for _, phase := range parsed.Phases {
691: 		sprints := make([]WebRoadmapSprint, 0, len(phase.Sprints))
692: 		for _, item := range phase.Sprints {
693: 			entry := WebRoadmapSprint{
694: 				Number:    item.Number,
695: 				Title:     item.Title,
696: 				Slug:      item.Slug,
697: 				Status:    string(item.Status),
698: 				Goal:      item.Goal,
699: 				GateItems: append([]string(nil), item.GateItems...),
700: 				DependsOn: append([]int(nil), item.DependsOn...),
701: 			}
702: 			if state, ok := live[item.Slug]; ok {
703: 				entry.Exists = true
704: 				entry.Assessment = state.Assessment
705: 				entry.TotalStages = len(state.Stages)
706: 				for _, stage := range state.Stages {
707: 					if stage.Status == "complete" || stage.Status == "completed" || stage.Status == "skipped" {
708: 						entry.CompletedStages++
709: 						continue
710: 					}
711: 					if entry.CurrentStage == "" {
712: 						entry.CurrentStage = stage.Name
713: 					}
714: 				}
715: 			}
716: 			sprints = append(sprints, entry)
717: 		}
718: 		phases = append(phases, WebRoadmapPhase{Title: phase.Title, Sprints: sprints})
719: 	}
720: 	for i, j := 0, len(phases)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
721: 		phases[i], phases[j] = phases[j], phases[i]
722: 	}
723: 	for i := range phases {
724: 		sprints := phases[i].Sprints
725: 		for a, b := 0, len(sprints)-1; a < b; a, b = a+1, b-1 {
726: 			sprints[a], sprints[b] = sprints[b], sprints[a]
727: 		}
728: 		phases[i].Sprints = sprints
729: 	}
730: 	return phases
731: }

777: func (u *webUseCases) Sprint(ctx context.Context, project, slug string) (WebSprintResult, error) {

779: 	if err != nil {
780: 		return WebSprintResult{}, err
781: 	}
782: 	for _, item := range items {
783: 		if item.Project == project && item.Slug == slug {
784: 			result := u.webSprint(item)
785: 			result.AttentionFindings = append([]DisplayFinding(nil), result.Findings...)
786: 			if len(result.AttentionFindings) > 3 {
787: 				result.AttentionFindings = result.AttentionFindings[:3]
788: 			}
789: 			result.Overview = u.sprintOverview(project, slug)
790: 			result.RunStages = sprintRunStages(item)
791: 			u.annotateStageModels(&result)
792: 			result.TotalStages = len(result.RunStages)
793: 			for _, stage := range result.RunStages {
794: 				if stage.Status == "complete" || stage.Status == "completed" || stage.Status == "skipped" {
795: 					result.CompletedStages++
796: 					continue
797: 				}
798: 				if result.CurrentStage == "" {
799: 					result.CurrentStage = stage.Name
800: 				}
801: 			}
802: 			u.enrichSprintDashboard(&result)
803: 			return result, nil
804: 		}
805: 	}
806: 	return WebSprintResult{}, ErrWebNotFound

809: func (u *webUseCases) PromptBundle(ctx context.Context, project, slug, stageName string) (WebPromptBundleResult, error) {
810: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
811: 		return WebPromptBundleResult{}, err
812: 	}
813: 	stage := sprint.PlanningStage(stageName)
814: 	result := WebPromptBundleResult{
815: 		Stage:         stage,
816: 		Scope:         "Deterministic stage preview",
817: 		InputContract: sprint.InputContract(stage),
818: 	}
819: 	service := u.dashboard.sprintService()
820: 	var (
821: 		preview sprint.PromptPreview
822: 		err     error
823: 	)
824: 	switch stage {
825: 	case sprint.StageRequirements:
826: 		preview, err = service.PromptRequirements(project, slug)
827: 	case sprint.StageCodeContext:

907: // dashboardMarkdown is a deliberately small reader for governed Markdown. It
908: // extracts useful previews while leaving the source documents authoritative.
909: type dashboardMarkdown struct {
910: 	sections map[string][]string
911: 	order    []string
912: }

914: func readDashboardMarkdown(path string) dashboardMarkdown {
915: 	result := dashboardMarkdown{sections: map[string][]string{}}
916: 	file, err := os.Open(path)
917: 	if err != nil {
918: 		return result
919: 	}
920: 	defer file.Close()
921: 	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, 64<<10))
922: 	if err != nil {
923: 		return result
924: 	}
925: 	section := ""
926: 	for _, raw := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
927: 		line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
928: 		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "## ") {
929: 			section = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "## ")))
930: 			result.order = append(result.order, section)
931: 			continue
932: 		}
933: 		if section != "" && line != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(line, "<!--") {
934: 			result.sections[section] = append(result.sections[section], line)
935: 		}
936: 	}
937: 	return result
938: }

940: func (m dashboardMarkdown) first(names ...string) string {
941: 	for _, name := range names {
942: 		for _, heading := range m.order {
943: 			lines := m.sections[heading]
944: 			if strings.EqualFold(heading, name) || strings.Contains(heading, strings.ToLower(name)) {
945: 				for _, line := range lines {
946: 					clean := cleanDashboardLine(line)
947: 					if clean != "" {
948: 						return clean
949: 					}
950: 				}
951: 			}
952: 		}
953: 	}
954: 	return ""
955: }

957: func (m dashboardMarkdown) items(names ...string) []string {
958: 	var out []string
959: 	for _, name := range names {
960: 		for _, heading := range m.order {
961: 			lines := m.sections[heading]
962: 			if !strings.EqualFold(heading, name) && !strings.Contains(heading, strings.ToLower(name)) {
963: 				continue
964: 			}
965: 			for _, line := range lines {
966: 				if strings.HasPrefix(line, "- ") || strings.HasPrefix(line, "* ") || strings.HasPrefix(line, "1. ") {
967: 					if value := cleanDashboardLine(line); value != "" {

970: 				}
971: 			}
972: 		}

977: func cleanDashboardLine(line string) string {
978: 	line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
979: 	line = strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "- "), "* "), "1. ")
980: 	line = strings.Trim(line, "`*# ")
981: 	if strings.HasPrefix(line, "[") && strings.Contains(line, "]:") {
982: 		line = strings.TrimSpace(strings.SplitN(line, "]:", 2)[1])
983: 	}

681: // projectRoadmap parses the project's governed roadmap and joins each entry
682: // with live sprint state when the sprint workspace exists.
683: func (u *webUseCases) projectRoadmap(projectName string, live map[string]SprintSummary) []WebRoadmapPhase {
684: 	content, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(u.root, "projects", projectName, "roadmap.md"))
685: 	if err != nil {
686: 		return nil
687: 	}
688: 	parsed, _ := project.ParseRoadmap(string(content))
689: 	phases := make([]WebRoadmapPhase, 0, len(parsed.Phases))
690: 	for _, phase := range parsed.Phases {
691: 		sprints := make([]WebRoadmapSprint, 0, len(phase.Sprints))
692: 		for _, item := range phase.Sprints {
693: 			entry := WebRoadmapSprint{
694: 				Number:    item.Number,
695: 				Title:     item.Title,
696: 				Slug:      item.Slug,
697: 				Status:    string(item.Status),
698: 				Goal:      item.Goal,
699: 				GateItems: append([]string(nil), item.GateItems...),
700: 				DependsOn: append([]int(nil), item.DependsOn...),
701: 			}
702: 			if state, ok := live[item.Slug]; ok {
703: 				entry.Exists = true
704: 				entry.Assessment = state.Assessment
705: 				entry.TotalStages = len(state.Stages)
706: 				for _, stage := range state.Stages {
707: 					if stage.Status == "complete" || stage.Status == "completed" || stage.Status == "skipped" {
708: 						entry.CompletedStages++
709: 						continue
710: 					}
711: 					if entry.CurrentStage == "" {
712: 						entry.CurrentStage = stage.Name
713: 					}
714: 				}
715: 			}
716: 			sprints = append(sprints, entry)
717: 		}
718: 		phases = append(phases, WebRoadmapPhase{Title: phase.Title, Sprints: sprints})
719: 	}
720: 	for i, j := 0, len(phases)-1; i < j; i, j = i+1, j-1 {
721: 		phases[i], phases[j] = phases[j], phases[i]
722: 	}
723: 	for i := range phases {
724: 		sprints := phases[i].Sprints
725: 		for a, b := 0, len(sprints)-1; a < b; a, b = a+1, b-1 {
726: 			sprints[a], sprints[b] = sprints[b], sprints[a]
727: 		}
728: 		phases[i].Sprints = sprints
729: 	}
730: 	return phases
731: }

809: func (u *webUseCases) PromptBundle(ctx context.Context, project, slug, stageName string) (WebPromptBundleResult, error) {
810: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
811: 		return WebPromptBundleResult{}, err
812: 	}
813: 	stage := sprint.PlanningStage(stageName)
814: 	result := WebPromptBundleResult{
815: 		Stage:         stage,
816: 		Scope:         "Deterministic stage preview",
817: 		InputContract: sprint.InputContract(stage),
818: 	}
819: 	service := u.dashboard.sprintService()
820: 	var (
821: 		preview sprint.PromptPreview
822: 		err     error
823: 	)
824: 	switch stage {
825: 	case sprint.StageRequirements:
826: 		preview, err = service.PromptRequirements(project, slug)
827: 	case sprint.StageCodeContext:
828: 		preview, err = service.PromptCodeContext(project, slug)
829: 	case sprint.StageSprintIndex:
830: 		preview, err = service.PromptSprintIndex(project, slug)
831: 	case sprint.StageTechnicalHandbook:
832: 		preview, err = service.PromptTechnicalHandbook(project, slug)
833: 	case sprint.StageAreaReasoning:
834: 		result.Scope = "First selected area prompt"
835: 		preview, err = service.PromptAreaReasoning(project, slug)
836: 	case sprint.StageReasoning:
837: 		preview, err = service.PromptReasoning(project, slug)
838: 	case sprint.StagePlan:
839: 		preview, err = service.PromptPlan(project, slug)
840: 	case sprint.StageExecute:
841: 		result.Scope = "One session for the ordered task queue"
842: 		preview, err = service.PromptExecute(project, slug, sprint.ExecuteRequest{})
843: 	case sprint.StageReview:
844: 		result.Scope = "Conformance Review manifest preview; worker suffixes vary"
845: 		preview, err = service.PromptReview(project, slug, sprint.ReviewRequest{})
846: 	case sprint.StageSmoke:
847: 		result.Scope = "Prepared after smoke harness discovery"
848: 		result.UnavailableReason = "The smoke prompt is assembled only after the governed harness and acceptance coverage are discovered."
849: 		return result, nil
850: 	default:
851: 		return WebPromptBundleResult{}, ErrWebNotFound
852: 	}
853: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
854: 		return WebPromptBundleResult{}, err
855: 	}
856: 	if err != nil {
857: 		result.UnavailableReason = displaySafe(err.Error())
858: 		return result, nil
859: 	}
860: 	explanation := preview.Explanation
861: 	if explanation == nil {
862: 		value := sprint.ExplainPrompt(preview.Prompt)
863: 		explanation = &value
864: 	}
865: 	contract := result.InputContract
866: 	explanation.InputContract = &contract
867: 	result.Available = true
868: 	result.Explanation = explanation
869: 	result.BlockContents = make([]string, 0, len(explanation.Blocks))
870: 	offset := 0
871: 	for _, block := range explanation.Blocks {
872: 		end := offset + block.Bytes
873: 		if end > len(preview.Prompt) {
874: 			result.BlockContents = nil
875: 			break
876: 		}
877: 		result.BlockContents = append(result.BlockContents, preview.Prompt[offset:end])
878: 		offset = end
879: 	}
880: 	return result, nil
881: }

893: 		if strings.HasPrefix(trimmed, "## ") {

895: 				break

903: 	}

907: // dashboardMarkdown is a deliberately small reader for governed Markdown. It
908: // extracts useful previews while leaving the source documents authoritative.
909: type dashboardMarkdown struct {
910: 	sections map[string][]string
911: 	order    []string
912: }
913: 
914: func readDashboardMarkdown(path string) dashboardMarkdown {
915: 	result := dashboardMarkdown{sections: map[string][]string{}}
916: 	file, err := os.Open(path)
917: 	if err != nil {
918: 		return result
919: 	}
920: 	defer file.Close()
921: 	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, 64<<10))
922: 	if err != nil {
923: 		return result
924: 	}
925: 	section := ""
926: 	for _, raw := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
927: 		line := strings.TrimSpace(raw)
928: 		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "## ") {
929: 			section = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "## ")))
930: 			result.order = append(result.order, section)
931: 			continue
932: 		}
933: 		if section != "" && line != "" && !strings.HasPrefix(line, "<!--") {
934: 			result.sections[section] = append(result.sections[section], line)
935: 		}
936: 	}
937: 	return result
938: }

940: func (m dashboardMarkdown) first(names ...string) string {
941: 	for _, name := range names {
942: 		for _, heading := range m.order {
943: 			lines := m.sections[heading]
944: 			if strings.EqualFold(heading, name) || strings.Contains(heading, strings.ToLower(name)) {
945: 				for _, line := range lines {
946: 					clean := cleanDashboardLine(line)
947: 					if clean != "" {
948: 						return clean
949: 					}
950: 				}
951: 			}
952: 		}
953: 	}
954: 	return ""
955: }

957: func (m dashboardMarkdown) items(names ...string) []string {
958: 	var out []string
959: 	for _, name := range names {
960: 		for _, heading := range m.order {
961: 			lines := m.sections[heading]

1304: 	}
1305: 	rel := target.values[0]
1306: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
1307: 		return WebArtifactPreview{}, err
1308: 	}
1309: 	if !supportedPreviewPath(rel) {
1310: 		return WebArtifactPreview{}, ErrWebNotFound
1311: 	}
1312: 	path, err := u.containedArtifactPath(rel)
1313: 	if err != nil {
1314: 		return WebArtifactPreview{}, ErrWebNotFound
1315: 	}

1318: 		if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
1319: 			return WebArtifactPreview{}, ErrWebNotFound
1320: 		}
1321: 		return WebArtifactPreview{}, fmt.Errorf("%w: artifact read", ErrWebUnavailable)
1322: 	}
1323: 	defer file.Close()

1325: 	if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
1326: 		return WebArtifactPreview{}, ErrWebNotFound
1327: 	}
1328: 	data, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, WebPreviewByteLimit+1))

1331: 	}
1332: 	truncated := len(data) > WebPreviewByteLimit

1335: 	}
1336: 	media := mediaTypeForPath(rel)
1337: 	return WebArtifactPreview{
1338: 		Ref:           ref,
1339: 		DisplayPath:   filepath.ToSlash(rel),
1340: 		MediaType:     media,
1341: 		Content:       string(data),
1342: 		SizeBytes:     info.Size(),
1343: 		ReturnedBytes: len(data),

128: 	layers := map[string]int{"primitive": 0, "component": 1, "layout": 2, "page": 3}

130: 		"primitive/empty", "component/artifacts", "component/findings", "component/operation-console",
131: 		"layout/top", "layout/bottom", "page/dashboard", "page/projects", "page/project", "page/sprint",
132: 		"page/studies", "page/study", "page/artifact", "page/operation-confirm", "page/operation", "page/error",
133: 	}
134: 	for _, name := range required {
135: 		if templates.Lookup(name) == nil {
136: 			return fmt.Errorf("required template %q is missing", name)
137: 		}
138: 	}
139: 	graph := make(map[string][]string)
140: 	for _, item := range templates.Templates() {
141: 		name := item.Name()
142: 		parts := strings.SplitN(name, "/", 2)
143: 		if len(parts) != 2 {
144: 			continue // ParseFS also exposes empty filename roots.
145: 		}
146: 		level, ok := layers[parts[0]]
147: 		if !ok {
148: 			return fmt.Errorf("template %q has an unsupported namespace", name)
149: 		}
150: 		dependencies := templateDependencies(item.Tree.Root)
151: 		for _, dependency := range dependencies {
152: 			dependencyParts := strings.SplitN(dependency, "/", 2)
153: 			dependencyLevel, ok := layers[dependencyParts[0]]
154: 			if len(dependencyParts) != 2 || !ok {
155: 				return fmt.Errorf("template %q depends on unnamespaced template %q", name, dependency)
156: 			}
157: 			if dependencyLevel >= level {
158: 				return fmt.Errorf("template %q has upward or same-layer dependency %q", name, dependency)
159: 			}
160: 		}
161: 		graph[name] = dependencies
162: 	}
163: 	visiting, visited := make(map[string]bool), make(map[string]bool)
164: 	var visit func(string) error
165: 	visit = func(name string) error {
166: 		if visiting[name] {
167: 			return fmt.Errorf("template dependency cycle includes %q", name)
168: 		}
169: 		if visited[name] {
170: 			return nil
171: 		}
172: 		visiting[name] = true
173: 		for _, dependency := range graph[name] {
174: 			if err := visit(dependency); err != nil {
175: 				return err
176: 			}
177: 		}
178: 		delete(visiting, name)
179: 		visited[name] = true
180: 		return nil
181: 	}
182: 	for name := range graph {
183: 		if err := visit(name); err != nil {
184: 			return err
185: 		}
186: 	}
187: 	return nil
188: }

141: 		name := item.Name()
142: 		parts := strings.SplitN(name, "/", 2)
143: 		if len(parts) != 2 {
144: 			continue // ParseFS also exposes empty filename roots.
145: 		}
146: 		level, ok := layers[parts[0]]
147: 		if !ok {
148: 			return fmt.Errorf("template %q has an unsupported namespace", name)
149: 		}
150: 		dependencies := templateDependencies(item.Tree.Root)
151: 		for _, dependency := range dependencies {
152: 			dependencyParts := strings.SplitN(dependency, "/", 2)
153: 			dependencyLevel, ok := layers[dependencyParts[0]]
154: 			if len(dependencyParts) != 2 || !ok {
155: 				return fmt.Errorf("template %q depends on unnamespaced template %q", name, dependency)
156: 			}
157: 			if dependencyLevel >= level {
158: 				return fmt.Errorf("template %q has upward or same-layer dependency %q", name, dependency)
159: 			}
160: 		}
161: 		graph[name] = dependencies
162: 	}
163: 	visiting, visited := make(map[string]bool), make(map[string]bool)
164: 	var visit func(string) error
165: 	visit = func(name string) error {
166: 		if visiting[name] {
167: 			return fmt.Errorf("template dependency cycle includes %q", name)
168: 		}
169: 		if visited[name] {
170: 			return nil
171: 		}
172: 		visiting[name] = true
173: 		for _, dependency := range graph[name] {
174: 			if err := visit(dependency); err != nil {
175: 				return err
176: 			}
177: 		}
178: 		delete(visiting, name)
179: 		visited[name] = true
180: 		return nil
181: 	}
182: 	for name := range graph {
183: 		if err := visit(name); err != nil {
184: 			return err
185: 		}
186: 	}
187: 	return nil
188: }

190: func templateDependencies(node parse.Node) []string {
191: 	var dependencies []string
192: 	var walk func(parse.Node)
193: 	walk = func(current parse.Node) {
194: 		switch value := current.(type) {
195: 		case *parse.ListNode:
196: 			if value != nil {
197: 				for _, child := range value.Nodes {
198: 					walk(child)
199: 				}
200: 			}
201: 		case *parse.TemplateNode:
202: 			dependencies = append(dependencies, value.Name)
203: 		case *parse.IfNode:
204: 			walk(value.List)
205: 			walk(value.ElseList)
206: 		case *parse.RangeNode:
207: 			walk(value.List)
208: 			walk(value.ElseList)
209: 		case *parse.WithNode:
210: 			walk(value.List)
211: 			walk(value.ElseList)
212: 		}
213: 	}
214: 	walk(node)
215: 	return dependencies
216: }

211: func (u dashboardUseCases) PrepareOperation(ctx context.Context, req OperationRequest) (Confirmation, error) {
212: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
213: 		return Confirmation{}, err
214: 	}
215: 	req.ExpectedFingerprint = ""
216: 	req = normalizeOperationRequest(req)
217: 	if err := validateOperationScope(req); err != nil {
218: 		return Confirmation{}, err
219: 	}
220: 	if err := validateQAOperationRequest(req); err != nil {
221: 		return Confirmation{}, err
222: 	}
223: 	if (req.Kind == OperationReviewStart || req.Kind == OperationReviewDryRun) && req.Parallelism <= 0 {
224: 		req.Parallelism = u.reviewConcurrency
225: 	}
226: 	c := Confirmation{Request: req, Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study), Permission: "workspace policy enforced"}
227: 	switch req.Kind {
228: 	case OperationValidate, OperationPrompt, OperationFlowDryRun, OperationStageDryRun, OperationExecuteDryRun, OperationExecuteStatus, OperationReviewDryRun, OperationReviewStatus, OperationSmokeStatus, OperationQAStatus:
229: 		c.Scope = []string{req.Stage}
230: 		c.Warning = "runtime-free; no runtime-backed writes"
231: 	case OperationQADryRun:
232: 		mapped, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
233: 		if err != nil {
234: 			return c, err
235: 		}
236: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("deterministic map %s", mapped.MapFingerprint), fmt.Sprintf("%d changed paths in %d bounded shards", mapped.ChangedPaths, mapped.TotalShards)}
237: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE; TARGET AND GOVERNED INPUTS READ-ONLY; NO QA STATE WRITE"
238: 	case OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume:
239: 		mapped, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
240: 		if err != nil {
241: 			return c, err
242: 		}
243: 		if req.Task != "" {
244: 			owned := false
245: 			for _, shard := range mapped.Shards {
246: 				owned = owned || shard.ID == req.Task
247: 			}
248: 			if !owned {
249: 				return c, fmt.Errorf("selected QA shard is not owned by the current map")
250: 			}
251: 		}
252: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, true
253: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("deterministic map %s", mapped.MapFingerprint), fmt.Sprintf("bounded concurrency and %d total shards", mapped.TotalShards)}
254: 		if req.Task != "" {
255: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "map-owned shard "+req.Task)
256: 		}
257: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + PRIVATE QA STATE WRITE; IMPLEMENTATION TARGET READ-ONLY"
258: 	case OperationQARecover:
259: 		c.Mutates = true
260: 		c.Scope = []string{"QA pointer, digest, interrupted ownership, flow summary, and retention reconciliation"}
261: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE QA RECOVERY; NO CHILD WORK"
262: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
263: 		c.Mutates = true
264: 		c.Scope = []string{"all sprint stages", "execute and Conformance Review state"}
265: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME-FREE; MAY REFRESH FLOW-STATE.JSON"
266: 	case OperationFlow:
267: 		c.Runtime = true
268: 		c.Mutates = true
269: 		c.Scope = []string{"planning stages through " + req.Stage}
270: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION"
271: 	case OperationStage:
272: 		c.Runtime = true
273: 		c.Mutates = true
274: 		c.Scope = []string{"selected planning stage only: " + req.Stage}
275: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + WORKSPACE MUTATION; PREREQUISITES MUST ALREADY BE VALID"
276: 	case OperationExecuteStart, OperationExecuteResume:
277: 		c.Runtime = true
278: 		c.Mutates = true
279: 		c.Scope = []string{"execute tasks"}
280: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + APPROVED TARGET MUTATION"
281: 	case OperationReviewStart:
282: 		c.Runtime = true
283: 		c.Mutates = true
284: 		c.Scope = []string{"one read-only Conformance Review worker per selected contract plus handbook", fmt.Sprintf("bounded parallelism: %d", req.Parallelism)}
285: 		if req.RestartReview {
286: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "discard resumable Conformance Review checkpoints and start fresh sessions")
287: 		}
288: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + REVIEW ARTIFACT WRITE (TARGET READ-ONLY)"
289: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun, OperationSmokeStart:
290: 		preview, err := u.sprintService().RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
291: 		if err != nil {
292: 			return c, err
293: 		}
294: 		c.Runtime = true
295: 		c.Mutates = req.Kind == OperationSmokeStart
296: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("%s %s", preview.ScopeKind, preview.Scope), preview.ScopeRationale, "prerequisites: " + strings.Join(preview.Prerequisites, ", "), "duration/cost: " + preview.DurationClass + "/" + preview.CostClass, fmt.Sprintf("timeout: %s (source: %s)", preview.EffectiveTimeout, preview.TimeoutSource), "safe command: " + preview.SafeArgv, "evidence roots: " + strings.Join(preview.EvidenceRoots, ", ")}
297: 		c.Warning = "EXTERNAL HARNESS + SMOKE ARTIFACT WRITE; RAW EVIDENCE REMAINS EXTERNAL"
298: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun, OperationVerifyStart:
299: 		c.Runtime, c.Mutates = true, req.Kind == OperationVerifyStart
300: 		c.Scope = []string{"complete execute evidence", "current Conformance Review", "Conformance Review-gated containing smoke scope"}
301: 		if req.ForceReview {
302: 			c.Scope = append(c.Scope, "DIAGNOSTIC OVERRIDE: "+req.OverrideRationale)
303: 		}
304: 		c.Warning = "ORDERED REVIEW -> SMOKE VERIFICATION; CANONICAL EVIDENCE ONLY AFTER VALIDATION"
305: 	case OperationStudyStart, OperationStudyResume:
306: 		if req.Parallelism < 1 || req.Parallelism > 64 {
307: 			return c, fmt.Errorf("parallelism must be between 1 and 64")
308: 		}
309: 		c.Runtime = true
310: 		c.Mutates = true
311: 		c.Scope = []string{fmt.Sprintf("study run-loop with %d parallel workers", req.Parallelism)}
312: 		c.Warning = "RUNTIME + STUDY STATE MUTATION"
313: 	case OperationStudyCancel:
314: 		c.Mutates = true
315: 		c.Scope = []string{"active study run-loop"}
316: 		c.Warning = "CANCEL ACTIVE RUN LOOP"
317: 	default:
318: 		return c, fmt.Errorf("unsupported operation %q", req.Kind)
319: 	}
320: 	if req.Project != "" {
321: 		if req.Sprint != "" {
322: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint}
323: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project + "/sprints/" + req.Sprint
324: 		} else {
325: 			c.Paths = []string{"projects/" + req.Project}
326: 			c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/projects/" + req.Project
327: 		}
328: 	} else {
329: 		c.Paths = []string{"studies/" + req.Study}
330: 		c.DurableRefreshPath = "/api/v1/studies/" + req.Study
331: 	}
332: 	if c.Mutates {
333: 		if req.Project != "" {
334: 			c.MutationClass = "sprint_mutation"
335: 		} else {
336: 			c.MutationClass = "study_mutation"
337: 		}
338: 	} else {
339: 		c.MutationClass = "read_only"
340: 	}
341: 	if c.Runtime {
342: 		c.ModelSource = operationRuntimeIdentity(req, u.stageRuntime)
343: 	}
344: 	c.Prerequisites = operationPrerequisites(req)
345: 	canonical, err := canonicalOperationRequest(req)
346: 	if err != nil {
347: 		return c, err
348: 	}
349: 	c.CanonicalRequest = canonical
350: 	c.GovernedInputs = governedOperationInputs(req)
351: 	fingerprintBasis := canonical + "\nruntime=" + c.ModelSource + "\nscope=" + strings.Join(c.Scope, "\x00")
352: 	fingerprint, err := fingerprintOperationInputs(u.root, fingerprintBasis, c.GovernedInputs)
353: 	if err != nil {
354: 		return c, err
355: 	}
356: 	c.InputFingerprint = fingerprint
357: 	c.Request.ExpectedFingerprint = fingerprint
358: 	return c, nil
359: }

361: func validateQAOperationRequest(req OperationRequest) error {
362: 	switch req.Kind {
363: 	case OperationQAStatus, OperationQADryRun, OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume, OperationQARecover:
364: 	default:
365: 		return nil
366: 	}
367: 	if req.Study != "" || req.Stage != "" || req.Model != "" || req.Level != "" || req.Suite != "" || req.Test != "" || req.Timeout != "" || req.ForceReview || req.RestartReview || req.OverrideRationale != "" || len(req.ReviewFocus) > 0 || len(req.Sources) > 0 || len(req.Dimensions) > 0 || req.Parallelism != 0 {
368: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA operations accept only project, sprint, and a map-owned shard")
369: 	}
370: 	if req.Task != "" && req.Kind != OperationQAStart && req.Kind != OperationQAResume {
371: 		return fmt.Errorf("QA shard is valid only for start or resume")
372: 	}
373: 	return nil
374: }

376: func (u dashboardUseCases) RunOperation(ctx context.Context, req OperationRequest, emit func(OperationEvent)) (OperationResult, error) {
377: 	expected := req.ExpectedFingerprint
378: 	req.ExpectedFingerprint = ""
379: 	prepared, err := u.PrepareOperation(ctx, req)
380: 	if err != nil {
381: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}, err)
382: 	}
383: 	if expected != "" && expected != prepared.InputFingerprint {
384: 		return failedOperation(OperationResult{Subject: prepared.Subject}, ErrStaleOperation)
385: 	}
386: 	req = prepared.Request
387: 	if emit == nil {
388: 		emit = func(OperationEvent) {}
389: 	}
390: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationRunning, Stage: req.Stage, Message: "operation started"})
391: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
392: 		return OperationResult{State: OperationCancelled}, err
393: 	}
394: 	ss := u.sprintService()
395: 	result := OperationResult{State: OperationComplete, Subject: operationFirstNonEmpty(req.Project+"/"+req.Sprint, req.Study)}
396: 	stage := sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage)
397: 	switch req.Kind {
398: 	case OperationValidate:
399: 		validationReq := ValidationRequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint, Study: req.Study, Stage: req.Stage}
400: 		switch {
401: 		case req.Study != "":
402: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationStudy
403: 		case req.Sprint != "":
404: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationSprint
405: 		default:
406: 			validationReq.Subject = ValidationProject
407: 		}
408: 		validation, err := u.Validate(ctx, validationReq)
409: 		if err != nil {
410: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
411: 		}
412: 		result.Message = validation.Status
413: 		result.Findings = append(result.Findings, validation.Findings...)
414: 	case OperationSprintStatus:
415: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
416: 		if err != nil {
417: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
418: 		}
419: 		result.Message = summarizeSprintStatus(r)
420: 	case OperationPrompt:
421: 		p, err := promptSprintStage(ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, stage)
422: 		if err != nil {
423: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
424: 		}
425: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(p.Prompt)
426: 	case OperationFlowDryRun:
427: 		r, err := runSprintFlow(ctx, ss, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
428: 		if err != nil {
429: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
430: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
431: 		}
432: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
433: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("flow to %s dry run", stage)
434: 	case OperationStageDryRun:
435: 		r, err := ss.FlowStage(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.FlowRequest{To: stage, DryRun: true})
436: 		if err != nil {
437: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
438: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
439: 		}
440: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Message)
441: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("single-stage %s dry run", stage)
442: 	case OperationExecuteDryRun:
443: 		r, err := ss.Execute(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ExecuteRequest{DryRun: true, TaskID: req.Task})
444: 		if err != nil {
445: 			result = operationWithSprintFindings(result, r.Findings)
446: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
447: 		}
448: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
449: 		result.Message = r.Message
450: 	case OperationExecuteStatus:
451: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
452: 		if err != nil {
453: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
454: 		}
455: 		execute := summarizeExecute(r.ExecuteState)
456: 		if !execute.Available {
457: 			result.Message = execute.Message
458: 		} else {
459: 			result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%d total: %d pending, %d running, %d complete, %d failed, %d cancelled", execute.Total, execute.Pending, execute.Running, execute.Complete, execute.Failed, execute.Cancelled)
460: 		}
461: 	case OperationReviewDryRun:
462: 		r, err := ss.Review(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Concurrency: req.Parallelism})
463: 		if err != nil {
464: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
465: 		}
466: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(r.Prompt)
467: 		result.Message = r.Message
468: 	case OperationReviewStatus:
469: 		r, err := ss.Status(req.Project, req.Sprint)
470: 		if err != nil {
471: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
472: 		}
473: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t next=%s", r.Verification.Review.ExecutionStatus, r.Verification.Review.Verdict, r.Verification.Review.Fresh, r.Verification.Review.NextAction)
474: 	case OperationSmokeStatus:
475: 		r, err := ss.VerificationStatus(req.Project, req.Sprint)
476: 		if err != nil {
477: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
478: 		}
479: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s verdict=%s fresh=%t run=%s issues=%d assessment=%s next=%s", r.Smoke.ExecutionStatus, r.Smoke.Verdict, r.Smoke.Fresh, r.Smoke.RunID, len(r.Smoke.Issues), r.Assessment, r.NextAction)
480: 	case OperationSmokeDryRun:
481: 		r, err := ss.RunSmoke(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true})
482: 		if err != nil {
483: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
484: 		}
485: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("%s %s: %s", r.ScopeKind, r.Scope, r.ScopeRationale)
486: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(sprint.RenderSmoke(r))
487: 	case OperationQAStatus:
488: 		qa, err := u.QAStatus(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
489: 		if err != nil {
490: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
491: 		}
492: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s fresh=%t shards=%d/%d next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.Fresh, qa.CompletedShards, qa.TotalShards, qa.NextAction)
493: 	case OperationQADryRun:
494: 		qa, err := u.QAMap(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
495: 		if err != nil {
496: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
497: 		}
498: 		data, _ := json.MarshalIndent(qa, "", "  ")
499: 		result.Content, result.Truncated = boundContent(string(data))
500: 		result.Message = "read-only QA map ready"
501: 	case OperationQARecover:
502: 		qa, err := u.RecoverQA(ctx, QARequest{Project: req.Project, Sprint: req.Sprint})
503: 		if err != nil {
504: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
505: 		}
506: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("phase=%s next=%s", qa.Phase, qa.NextAction)
507: 	case OperationVerifyDryRun:
508: 		r, err := ss.Verify(ctx, req.Project, req.Sprint, sprint.VerifyRequest{To: sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage), DryRun: true, Review: sprint.ReviewRequest{DryRun: true, Focus: req.ReviewFocus, Restart: req.RestartReview}, Smoke: sprint.SmokeRequest{Level: req.Level, Suite: req.Suite, Test: req.Test, ForceReview: req.ForceReview, OverrideConfirmed: req.ForceReview, OverrideRationale: req.OverrideRationale, DryRun: true}})
509: 		if err != nil {
510: 			return failedOperation(result, err)
511: 		}
512: 		result.Message = fmt.Sprintf("assessment=%s next=%s", r.Verification.Assessment, r.Verification.NextAction)
513: 	default:
514: 		if u.runner == nil {
515: 			return failedOperation(result, fmt.Errorf("runtime-backed operation is unavailable without configured composition"))
516: 		}
517: 		return u.runner(ctx, req, emit)
518: 	}
519: 	emit(OperationEvent{State: OperationComplete, Stage: req.Stage, Message: operationFirstNonEmpty(result.Message, "operation complete")})
520: 	return result, nil
521: }

541: func validateOperationScope(req OperationRequest) error {
542: 	for name, value := range map[string]string{"project": req.Project, "sprint": req.Sprint, "study": req.Study} {
543: 		if value == "" {
544: 			continue
545: 		}
546: 		if value == "." || value == ".." || len(value) > 128 || strings.ContainsAny(value, `/\\`) {
547: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation %s reference", name)
548: 		}
549: 		for _, r := range value {
550: 			if (r >= 'a' && r <= 'z') || (r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z') || (r >= '0' && r <= '9') || r == '.' || r == '_' || r == '-' {
551: 				continue
552: 			}
553: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid operation %s reference", name)
554: 		}
555: 	}
556: 	return nil
557: }

559: func normalizedStrings(values []string) []string {
560: 	seen := make(map[string]struct{}, len(values))
561: 	out := make([]string, 0, len(values))
562: 	for _, value := range values {
563: 		value = strings.TrimSpace(value)
564: 		if value == "" {
565: 			continue
566: 		}
567: 		if _, ok := seen[value]; ok {
568: 			continue
569: 		}
570: 		seen[value] = struct{}{}
571: 		out = append(out, value)
572: 	}
573: 	sort.Strings(out)
574: 	return out
575: }

603: func operationRuntimeIdentity(req OperationRequest, stages map[sprint.PlanningStage]sprint.StageRuntime) string {
604: 	if req.Model != "" {
605: 		return "requested model " + req.Model
606: 	}
607: 	stage := sprint.PlanningStage(req.Stage)
608: 	switch req.Kind {
609: 	case OperationExecuteStart, OperationExecuteResume:
610: 		stage = sprint.StageExecute
611: 	case OperationReviewStart:
612: 		stage = sprint.StageReview
613: 	case OperationSmokeStart, OperationVerifyStart:
614: 		stage = sprint.StageSmoke
615: 	case OperationQAStart, OperationQAResume:
616: 		return "configured QA runtime"
617: 	}
618: 	if runtime, ok := stages[stage]; ok && (runtime.Model != "" || runtime.Variant != "") {
619: 		return strings.TrimSpace(runtime.Model + " variant=" + runtime.Variant)
620: 	}
621: 	if req.Kind == OperationSmokeStart {
622: 		return "configured smoke author and harness"
623: 	}
624: 	return "effective workspace runtime configuration"
625: }
